Subject:
Request a Non-Reimbursable Detail of Rebecca Webb to DDI/DRG from the
Department of State's (DoS) Global Engagement Center (GEC)
Recommendation: Approve the four (4) month non-reimbursable detail request for Rebecca
Webb to USAID/DDI/DRG from the DoS/GEC
Approve
/s/
Disapprove
BACKGROUND:
USAID developed the attached MOU with the Department of State's GEC to temporarily
detail Ms. Rebecca Webb to DDI's DRG Center. A senior adviser at GEC, Ms. Webb would
support the DRG Center in its work to deter and combat mis/dis/malinformation (MDM) and
incorporate these efforts into the Summit for Democracy Year of Action activities. She will
leverage her extensive experience working across the interagency on these issues to enhance our
coordination with the National Security Council, DoS, and other USG agencies. She will also
support the DRG Center in developing strategic approaches and tools regarding MDM and
digital technology. Ms. Webb recently completed a detail in PPL where she supported USAID in
interagency processes related to the People's Republic of China (PRC), disinformation and other
related topics. DDI/DRG seeks to build on this important work and her skills in developing its
programming approach and interagency coordination on these critical issues.
The Memorandum of Understanding documenting the partnership between USAID and
DoS is attached at (Tab 1) for reference.
AUTHORITIES:
Pursuant to the Automated Directives System Chapter 103.3.10, the Administrator has
delegated to the AtA HCTM primary responsibility for all aspects of human resources
management. As the Acting CHCO, you may approve details out of the Agency through your
alter ego authority with the AtA HCTM.
RESOURCE IMPLICATIONS:
The DoS will continue to pay her salary and benefits. USAID resources would be limited
to provision of a laptop and relevant work products during her detail.
